title: Maintenance optimization of a two-component system with mixed observability
summary: This paper studies maintenance optimization for a two-component system under mixed observability. Component~$U_1$ is fully monitored, whereas component~$U_2$ is only partially observable due to sensing limitations. The system exhibits unidirectional positive degradation dependence, in which the health state of component~$U_1$ influences the degradation process of component~$U_2$, but not vice versa.
